## Vendor Onboarding App

The buyer's intake console. Every Vendor Profile in the realm is laid out as a vetting pipeline (intake → under review → approved → onboarded, with rejected profiles parked in their own column), and compliance state shows on every card. The masthead says what is waiting on the buyer right now: how many profiles need review and how many carry lapsed compliance.

The app holds no data of its own. Vendor Profile carries the dossier and the Onboard action (Onboard Vendor command); the app live-queries the profiles and arranges them on the shared Status Board, whose columns and legal moves come from the profile's status field. Dragging a profile to onboarded is refused, because activation has to go through the Onboard Vendor command on the profile, which creates the active Vendor record.

### Example

The linked instance opens on the catalog's Vendor Profiles: Acme Supply and TechSource (onboarded), Norvik Ltd (approved but award-blocked on a lapsed ISO 9001), Helio Freight (in intake) and Brightline Packaging (under review).

### Non-goals

No vendor-facing signup or portal: one persona, the buyer. No approval workflow of its own: status changes happen on the profile and through the Onboard Vendor command, never from this console.
